evals.prompt: Revise and expand this Chapter 1 paragraph: 'Our capstone system eliminates plagiarism and saves all instructors 80% of their time.' Available evidence: the approved design centralizes manuscript submissions and displays similarity matches. No time study or detection evaluation has been performed. Provide revised prose and a separate gap report. Follow ISO patterns without changing the approved scope.
evals.expected_output: Substantive bounded prose about intended workflow and academic review; no asserted 80% saving or elimination of plagiarism; separate evidence gaps and evaluation needs.

evals.prompt: Audit Chapter 1 objectives: build the app, make it effective, and prove it is ISO certified. The proposal covers student submissions and adviser review at one university; evaluation is planned through task testing and a usability questionnaire. Suggest precise objectives, explain what is lacking, and improve phrasing without inventing thresholds or expanding the project to other universities.
evals.expected_output: Objectives aligned to implementation, task testing, and perceived usability; no certification claim or arbitrary targets; explicit scope and method gaps.
